title: Take five quiet minutes
description: Give yourself a short stretch of time with nothing you need to accomplish.
first_step: Put your phone down and choose a comfortable place to sit or lie down.
plan_steps: Get comfortable.
Set aside five minutes.
Let yourself be still without trying to finish anything.

title: Make a drink and change rooms
description: Make a small change of pace by getting a drink and spending a few minutes somewhere else.
first_step: Get some water or make a drink you already have.
plan_steps: Choose a drink.
Move to another comfortable spot.
Stay there for a few minutes before deciding what to do next.

title: Listen to one favorite song
description: Take a short break with a song you already know you enjoy.
first_step: Choose one song you already know you enjoy.
plan_steps: Play one favorite song.
Listen without choosing what comes next until the song ends.

title: Walk around your home
description: Get up and spend a few minutes moving through your space.
first_step: Stand up from where you are.
plan_steps: Stand up.
Walk through one or two rooms.
Return when you feel ready.

title: Take a gentle stretch break
description: Spend a few minutes doing comfortable, easy movements.
first_step: Stand or sit comfortably and choose one area that feels comfortable to move.
plan_steps: Choose a comfortable position.
Make a few gentle movements.
Stop whenever you are ready.

title: Take a short walk outside
description: Step outside for a short walk without needing a particular destination.
first_step: Put on whatever you need to comfortably step outside.
plan_steps: Step outside.
Choose an easy nearby direction.
Walk for a short while and return when you are ready.

title: Notice five things around you
description: Shift your attention away from what you were doing and notice your immediate surroundings.
first_step: Look away from your screen and choose one object nearby.
plan_steps: Notice one thing near you.
Find four more things you had not been paying attention to.
Return to what you were doing when you are ready.

title: Spend a few minutes looking outside
description: Give your attention to what is happening outside for a few minutes.
first_step: Go to a window, doorway, balcony, or another place where you can look outside.
plan_steps: Find a comfortable place to look outside.
Notice what is happening without needing to do anything about it.
Stay for a few minutes.

title: Clear one small surface
description: Choose one small area instead of trying to clean an entire room.
first_step: Choose just one small surface, such as part of a desk, table, or counter.
plan_steps: Pick one small surface.
Remove or put away what does not belong there.
Stop when that one area is done.

title: Put away five things
description: Make a tiny improvement to your space without starting a full cleanup.
first_step: Find the first nearby item that already has a place where it belongs.
plan_steps: Put away one item.
Repeat until you have put away five things.
Stop at five.

title: Do one tiny puzzle or game
description: Choose a small game or puzzle you can enjoy without turning it into a long session.
first_step: Choose something you can start in less than a minute.
plan_steps: Pick one short puzzle or game.
Play one round or complete one small challenge.
Decide whether you want to stop or continue afterward.

title: Revisit something that makes you laugh
description: Spend a few minutes with something you already find funny.
first_step: Think of one photo, clip, comic, memory, or joke you enjoy.
plan_steps: Choose one funny thing.
Spend a few minutes enjoying it.
Stop when you feel ready.

title: Send one low-pressure check-in
description: Reach out to someone without needing to start a long conversation.
first_step: Pick one person you would be happy to hear from.
plan_steps: Choose one person.
Send a simple message such as asking how they are doing.
Let them respond whenever they have time.

title: Invite someone to take a short break
description: Ask someone to join you for a small shared break or activity.
first_step: Think of someone nearby or available right now.
plan_steps: Choose one person.
Invite them to do something small together.
Keep the invitation easy to accept or decline.

title: Read a few pages about something you like
description: Spend a short block of time reading something chosen because it interests you.
first_step: Open something you already wanted to read.
plan_steps: Choose a book, article, guide, or other reading.
Read for a few pages or about ten minutes.
Stop at a natural point.

title: Learn one small thing you have wondered about
description: Answer one small question rather than starting a whole course or project.
first_step: Choose one question you have wondered about recently.
plan_steps: Write or say the question clearly.
Look for one useful explanation.
Stop once you can explain the basic answer to yourself.

title: Improve one resume bullet
description: Make one small career-related improvement instead of trying to overhaul your whole resume.
first_step: Open your resume and choose only one bullet.
plan_steps: Choose one existing bullet.
Look for one way to make the action or result clearer.
Save the change and stop there.

title: Make a tiny doodle
description: Create something small without needing it to be polished or useful.
first_step: Grab scrap paper, a notebook, or a drawing app.
plan_steps: Choose any simple shape or idea.
Draw for a few minutes.
Stop whenever it feels finished enough.

title: Take one unfamiliar turn on a walk
description: Add a small amount of novelty to a walk in an area where you already feel comfortable.
first_step: Choose a nearby walking route you already feel comfortable starting.
plan_steps: Begin on a familiar route.
Choose one different nearby turn or path.
Return to familiar surroundings whenever you want.

title: Try a nearby cafe or snack spot
description: Visit a nearby place you have noticed or been curious about.
first_step: Think of one nearby place you have noticed but have not tried.
plan_steps: Choose one nearby place.
Check that it fits the time and money you want to spend.
Go there and try one thing if you still feel like it.
